test_title: PYST 14: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters which, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will

complete the letter series.

f h _ h _ g f _ h g _ h _ f f _ g _ h _ f
solution:
Given series: f h _ h _ g f _ h g _ h _ f f _ g _ h _ f

Option 1) tphthghg → f h __t__ h __p__ g f __h__ h g __t__ h __h__ f f **__g__** g __h__ h __g__ f → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) phthghfg → f h __p__ h __h__ g f __t__ h g __h__ h __g__ f f __h__ g __f__ h __g__ f → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) phthfghg → f h __p__ h __h__ g f __t__ h g __h__ h __f__ f f __g__ g __h__ h __g__ f → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) ghfhghhg → f h __**g**__ h __**h**__ g f __**f**__ h g __**h**__ h __**g**__ f f __**h**__ g __**h**__ h __**g**__ f → (It follows the pattern of: fhghhgf - fhghhgf - fhghhgf)

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
